title: Smoky Beetroot Gratin
description: A delicious French-inspired beetroot gratin with a smoky twist.
instructions: 2. Slice the beetroot into 1cm thick rounds.
3. In a separate bowl, mix together the roasted garlic, smoked cheddar cheese, and heavy cream.
4. Grease a small baking dish with butter.
5. Arrange a layer of beetroot slices in the dish.
6. Pour some of the cheese and cream mixture over the beetroot.
7. Repeat steps 5 and 6 until all the ingredients are used up, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
8. Dot the top of the gratin with butter.
9. Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
10. Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme.
